tasks.spec: Design Maya's corrected Orgo + Hermes baseline and eve comparison without changing production, then turn the winning pattern into a reusable template for all seven named agents. Address the `ORGO_PE_CC_MAYA_API_KEY` to client `ORGO_API_KEY` mapping without exposing secrets; verify account-wide versus workspace scope and never infer computer isolation from the variable name. Define one dedicated Orgo workspace, workspace-scoped key, computer, Google identity, Hermes home, Slack identity, and least-privilege Command Center identity per agent. Include Jordan and Sam as dedicated-desktop targets. Preserve Rowan's external-only boundary and every role-specific authority limit. Design a Hermes-native T0/T1/T2 model ladder with cheap auxiliary models, task-level escalation, token budgets, cost receipts, provider data controls, and benchmark gates. Discover and reuse existing desktops rather than provisioning duplicates. Cover Gmail API-first versus browser fallback, secret storage, health checks, outbound approval, account isolation, observability, duplicate-event prevention, serial rollout, and operator recovery.
